rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This Azure Assistant MCP server by iOSDevil provides intelligent Azure resource querying by generating and executing Azure Resource Graph (ARG) KQL queries from natural language questions. Built with multi-tenant support through service principal authentication, it features automatic tenant detection from query context, management group scoping for enterprise environments, and heuristic natural-language-to-KQL conversion for common scenarios like finding stopped VMs, public IPs, unencrypted storage accounts, and Key Vault configurations. The implementation includes subscription auto-discovery, diagnostic tools for troubleshooting scope and permissions, and cross-tenant VM counting capabilities, making it ideal for Azure administrators, cloud architects, and DevOps teams who need conversational access to Azure resource inventory and compliance checking across multiple tenants and subscriptions.
